title: 📈 Game Flow
notes: 📈 Full-screen matchups have a new Game Flow chart: both teams' scores over the week, lead changes, a dashed line to each projected finish, and a win % strip underneath. Drag across it to see the score and the plays at any moment.
🔥 Scoring plays: every score for either team shows up in a feed as it happens (big plays are highlighted). Points scored while the app was closed show up as "away". Tap a play to see how it scored.
📊 New mini charts: points by position for both lineups, and a Path to Win card that shows what each side still needs.
🟩 Each player's row now has a thin bar showing how close they are to their projection.
🏈 Psst… when ESPN is down there's something to do while you wait. (Or tap the week title in full screen five times.)
